cards.title: minVol is an absolute volume, not a cell fraction
cards.when: any edit of system/meshQualityDict for pore meshes with a small cell
cards.statement: In meshQualityDict minVol/minTetQuality are absolute volumes (m³) of the face–cell-centre pyramid, not a cell fraction. The template minVol 1e-13 is intended for ~1 mm cells; with pore cells of 5e-16…1.7e-11 m³ it flags normal cells as illegal.
recipe: minVol ≈ h_min³ / 6, where h_min is the minimum cell size in metres
pore mesh with a 0.05–0.1 mm cell → minVol 1e-16…1e-14
set it explicitly in system/meshQualityDict and in the gate: mesh_gate.sh --min-vol 1e-14
evidence: exp-005: the template minVol 1e-13 gave 419 044 illegal faces and `Extruding 0 out of 52592 faces (0%)` — no layers grew
exp-003: 63 792 and 70 784 “bad” faces on a formally sound mesh, cell 0.063 mm

cards.title: STL in mm → scale 0.001 and locationInMesh in metres
cards.when: the STL is in millimetres (project contract) while the OpenFOAM case is in metres
cards.statement: snappyHexMeshDict geometry{...} needs `scale 0.001`, and locationInMesh/locationsInMesh must be in metres. Otherwise snappy looks for the inside point in mm coordinates and fails.
recipe: geometry { interface.stl { type triSurfaceMesh; name interface; scale 0.001; } }
locationsInMesh ( ((0.00176776695 0.00176776695 -0.0120) fluid) ) — coordinates in metres
STL is always in mm; convertToMeters 0.001 in blockMeshDict
evidence: AGENTS.md §13, project trap: `FOAM FATAL ERROR: Point (...) is not inside the mesh or on a face or edge`

cards.title: One-sided interface faces — debris on the domain planes
cards.when: after splitMeshRegions one region has interface faces and the other does not (mismatched interface)
cards.statement: The cause is geometry spots on the domain planes: the intersection of the STL with the block boundary produces extra faces, and snappy makes the interface one-sided. The fix is to remove the triangles lying on the domain planes before meshing.
recipe: Find the spot area on the planes (plane_tol 1e-6) and delete those triangles from the STL
Then rebuild the case: blockMesh → surfaceFeatureExtract → snappy → splitMeshRegions
Verify: the interface face count matches in both regions and so does the area
evidence: exp-018: 108.189 mm² of spots → 14 620 extra faces; after drop_domain_plane_faces=true (plane_tol=1e-6) solid stray 0, fluid 14
exp-005 (reference): interface 26 296 ↔ 26 296 faces, volume sums match

cards.title: Level 2 on the interface removes the main non-orthogonality peak
cards.when: maxNonOrtho > 60° and the worst faces lie on the fluid↔solid interface
cards.statement: refinementSurfaces interface { level (2 2); } cuts maxNonOrtho from 72.72° to 28.03° at the cost of +50.3 % cells. This is the most effective single lever in the studied set.
recipe: refinementSurfaces { interface { level (2 2); patchInfo { type wall; } } }
features { file "interface.eMesh"; level 1; } — feature level below the surface level
then mesh_gate.sh --profile project; on failure read the per-threshold mesh_gate output
evidence: exp-018: v13_best — fluid 331 792 cells, maxNonOrtho 18.71°, skew 1.175; solid 243 965, 26.54°; 62 s; project gate rc=0

cards.title: Layers are the main source of non-orthogonality
cards.when: layers are on, maxNonOrtho is high, and the mesh passes without layers
cards.statement: In the studied case maxNonOrtho is 39.20° without layers and 72.72° with them. Raise the interface level and the snap quality first, and only then add layers — or judge the gate verdict without layers.
recipe: Diagnosis: build a variant with addLayers false and compare maxNonOrtho
Introduce layers once castellation+snap gives acceptable non-orthogonality
castellatedBufferLayer gives a slightly better solid (61.70°) but is three times slower
evidence: exp-018: separate runs with and without layers; exp-005: castellatedBufferLayer 367 293 cells, 64.90°, skew 1.74, 0 illegal, 74 s
improves: an informed choice: layers or quality

cards.title: castellatedBufferLayer fails without _meshMotionSolver
cards.statement: The castellatedBufferLayer type requires a `_meshMotionSolver` block (displacementPointSmoothing + `pointSmoother laplacian`) and a `${_meshMotionSolver}` reference in snapControls; otherwise the “Inflating buffer layers” step fails with `Entry 'solver' not found`. addLayersControls requires nRelaxIter.
recipe: _meshMotionSolver { displacementPointSmoothing { pointSmoother laplacian; } }
snapControls { solver ${_meshMotionSolver}; ... }
addLayersControls { nRelaxIter 10; ... }
evidence: exp-005: `FOAM FATAL IO ERROR: Entry 'solver' not found in ... snapControls` during the Inflating buffer layers step

cards.title: Levers that gave nothing in this case
cards.when: tempted to “tweak parameters” instead of changing the level or the geometry
cards.statement: Verified on exp-018: maxNonOrtho 65→60 made things worse (75.69°); nCellsBetweenLevels 4→2 is nearly neutral; resolveFeatureAngle 60 is neutral; allowFreeStandingZoneFaces false does not fix a one-sided interface. Do not spend time on these knobs — geometry, interface level and layers come first.
recipe: Order of work: remove the plane spots → level 2 on the interface → layers → only then the small knobs
Each variant gets its own directory and metrics row
evidence: exp-018 REPORT.md: table of 30 variants, the listed knobs without a gain

cards.title: Outer flat boundaries — type symmetry during meshing
cards.when: the domain is bounded by planes that are physically a symmetry or a wall
cards.statement: The patch type on an outer plane makes snap move points off the plane (9.53 µm, 1444/1580 non-planar faces). The symmetry type keeps the plane exact (0…4.9e-14 mm, 0 non-planar faces). Set the physical type after meshing by editing constant/polyMesh/boundary — changeDictionary does not work in region mode.
recipe: blockMeshDict: patch world { type symmetry; faces (...); }
after meshing: edit constant/<region>/polyMesh/boundary, type patch/wall/cyclic
patchInfo { type symmetry; } does NOT retype patches that already exist in blockMeshDict
evidence: exp-006: patch — 1826/1827 points off the plane, 1444/1580 non-planar faces; symmetry — 0 non-planar
exp-006: patchInfo with symmetry left inlet/outlet as patch (28…32 µm) and gave 143 illegal faces, maxSkew 399, Failed 5 mesh checks in solid

cards.title: Verified snappy step sequence in parallel
cards.when: building a snappy case with regions on 6+ cores
cards.statement: Working chain: clean old regions/fields → blockMesh → surfaceFeatureExtract → decomposePar -force → mpirun snappyHexMesh -parallel -overwrite → reconstructParMesh -constant -mergeTol 1e-6 → checkMesh → splitMeshRegions -cellZones -overwrite → checkMesh per region.
recipe: rm -rf constant/{polyMesh,fluid,solid,cellToRegion,extendedFeatureEdgeMesh} processor*
delete 0/{cellToRegion,cellLevel,pointLevel,nSurfaceLayers,thickness,thicknessFraction} before rebuilding
mpirun --allow-run-as-root -np 6 snappyHexMesh -parallel -overwrite
reconstructParMesh -constant -mergeTol 1e-6; then splitMeshRegions -cellZones -overwrite
evidence: exp-018 scripts/run_variant.sh — full pipeline, exit codes 11–16 per step; v13_best built by this chain in 62 s

cards.title: A bare checkMesh is not a quality gate
cards.when: a decision “is the mesh usable” is needed
cards.statement: checkMesh without -meshQuality does not test non-orthogonality against a threshold: only >90° is an error, while >70° is merely counted and printed. Threshold checks are enabled only by the -meshQuality flag with system/meshQualityDict — in this project that is tools/qa/mesh_gate.sh.
recipe: tools/qa/mesh_gate.sh --case <case> --profile project --min-vol <h_min³/6>
project targets: maxNonOrtho ≤ 60°, internal skew ≤ 2, boundary skew ≤ 4, minFaceWeight ≥ 0.1, minVolRatio ≥ 0.05, minDeterminant ≥ 0.001, negative volume 0
layers: ≥ 3–5 at the wall, coverage > 0.8
evidence: AGENTS.md §6 (checked against the v2512 sources: primitiveMesh::nonOrthThreshold_ = 70, polyMeshCheck.C)
exp-018: v13_best passes project rc=0; variants at 61–75° do not
